Q1.question: 20 years old or older?
Q1.supportiveText: At 20+, alcohol of any strength can be bought, subject to the intoxication check.

Q2.question: Visibly intoxicated?
Q2.supportiveText: Sale is refused to anyone visibly intoxicated, regardless of age.

Q3.question: 18 years old or older?
Q3.supportiveText: 18-19 year olds may only buy folk alcohol (low alcohol content).

Q4.question: Visibly intoxicated?
Q4.supportiveText: Sale is refused to anyone visibly intoxicated, regardless of age.

OUT_CannotBuy.label: Cannot buy alcohol
OUT_CannotBuy.description: The person may not purchase alcohol under these facts.

OUT_CanBuyAnywhere.label: Can buy alcohol anywhere
OUT_CanBuyAnywhere.description: The person may purchase alcohol of any strength.

OUT_FolkOnly.label: Can buy folk alcohol only
OUT_FolkOnly.description: The person may purchase only folk (low-alcohol) beverages.
